summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Desync feature review (DESYNC10 coupon, dynamic categories, sold-out logic, PayPal hidden). All 9 backend pytest tests pass; all frontend UI flows verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1080 lines; consider splitting into routers (products/categories/coupons/payments/paypal/admin) for maintainability.

hero-stat-games text renders as concatenation '1Games' (value+label). This is a stylistic point only — value & label are on separate lines visually but concatenated in textContent; tests targeting textContent should account for that.

PayPal backend endpoints still active while UI is hidden — kept intentionally per user request, but note that /api/paypal/create is publicly reachable and could be used to place orders without a UI. Recommend gating server-side too if the intent is 'fully off'.

seed_products() only seeds if DB is empty — safe. However SEED_PRODUCTS still contains the non-FiveM legacy products; if the DB is ever wiped they will come back and contradict the current curated state. Consider updating SEED_PRODUCTS or gating with an env flag.
seed_data_creation: Tests create+delete a temporary category (TEST_/TESTRust*); no lingering data. Also created a Stripe checkout session for SPECTRE 1-day + DESYNC10 (order left in 'pending' state, not paid — acceptable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_desync_features.py cover categories CRUD, category-delete protection (FiveM in-use), DESYNC10 coupon presence/math, invalid coupon, absence of legacy 5% coupon, sold-out enforcement at checkout, and 10% discount math on Stripe session. Frontend flows verified: hero-discount-chip='10% off site-wide — code DESYNC10', hero-badge='FiveM', hero-stat-games='1', filter tabs=['All','FiveM'], 2 product cards (SPECTRE, PHANTOM), no sold-out badges (both have stock), modal shows Add-to-Cart, PayPal absent from cart, DESYNC10 applied (€6.99 -> €6.29), invalid coupon shows 'Invalid or expired code' toast, admin Categories tab creates/deletes categories, duplicate returns error, FiveM deletion blocked with 'used by ... product(s) — reassign' message, product form has category dropdown listing 'FiveM'.
